notes_for_us: The core of this request - play a 3D machine through UI buttons from a fixed camera - is a real spatial arrangement (machine, camera position, button panel) and only the machine has anywhere to go. SET says nobody walks; it does not say where the camera stands or where the controls live.

'A few arcade games to choose from' is a set of display sets, and one shape is one space. Either the other machines are dressing in this room or each is its own scene, and that is a P4 decision the prompt cannot settle.
